title: Ground the Knowledge Assistant
tagline: Teach it to say "I don't know"
objective: Refuse to answer when there is nothing to answer from.
description: The assistant searches your support handbook and then answers the question. When the handbook has the answer, it is excellent. When the search comes back empty, it answers anyway - confidently, and entirely from imagination. Add a Condition that checks whether any documents came back, and send the empty branch to a Safe Stop that admits it does not know.

sample_input.question: How do I reset a customer password?

expected_output: Either a grounded answer that cites handbook documents, or a safe stop that refuses to answer because no evidence was found.

config.prompt: Answer the question using only the retrieved documents. Return JSON with answer, citations (document ids) and grounded (boolean).
config.system: You answer only from the documents you were given. If they do not cover the question, say so.

solution_hint: Add a Condition between 'Search the handbook' and 'Answer with evidence'. Point it at the field 'documents' with the operator 'is not empty'. Wire its true branch to the AI Model and its false branch to a new Safe Stop that explains the assistant found nothing to answer from.

failure_scenarios.label: The handbook comes back empty
failure_scenarios.description: The search returns zero documents every time - there is simply no evidence to answer from.

completion_criteria: The assistant searches the handbook before it answers
An empty search sends the run down a Safe Stop branch
The workflow stops safely instead of inventing an answer

data.answer: Open the customer record in the admin console, choose Security, then Send reset link. The customer gets a one-time link that expires after 60 minutes. Never set a password on their behalf.

how do i reset a customer password?.title: Resetting a customer password
how do i reset a customer password?.content: Open the customer record in the admin console, choose Security, then Send reset link. The link expires after 60 minutes.

how do i reset a customer password?.title: What agents must never do with credentials
how do i reset a customer password?.content: Agents must never set or read a customer password. Always send the self-service reset link instead.
